title: O HAPPY DAY! THAT FIXED MY CHOICE
stanzas: O happy day! that fixed my choice On Thee, my Saviour and my God; Well may this glowing heart rejoice, And tell its raptures all abroad.
O happy ond, that seals my vows To Him Who meris all my love! Let cheerful anthems fill His house While to the sacred shrine I move
'Tis done, the great transaction's done; I am my Lord's, and He is mine; He drew me and J followed on, Charmed to confess the voice divine.
Now rest, my long-divided heart, Fixed on this blissful center, rest; Heree have I found aa nobler part; Here heavenly pleasures fill my breast.
High Heaven, that heard the solemn vow, That vow renewed shall daily hear, Till in life's latest hour I boll', And bless in death a bond so dear.
chorus: Happy day, happy day, When Jesus washed my sins away! He taught me how to watch and pray, And live rejoicing every day; Happy day, happy day, When Jesus washed my sins away!
